title: Device agent attestation (compact JWS), contract v1 (DRAFT v1-d2)
description: Sent by the page as device_attestation (contract-v1.md 6.4-6.8). Format [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-8/OQ-9; SRC: LD §16.18.5 L1381-1386]. Lifetime, single use, nonce and device binding [SRC: LD §16.18.5 L1365, L1371; PLAN §1.2 L51]. Checks a schema can't express (signature, kid in the enrolled device key registry, exp - iat <= 60 s, nonce unconsumed) are server checks, 6.7.

device_id.description: Enrolled device id. Real: format not stated [SSE Proposal -> OQ-35: UUID string]. Stand-in: starts standin- [SSE Proposal -> OQ-33].

alg.description: ES256 only [TL Decision 2026-11-02]. Never none or HS*.

header.$comment: The key comes only from the enrolled device key registry by kid; embedded or remote key references are refused [SSE Proposal -> OQ-35].

nonce.description: The login service's transaction nonce, echoed [TL Decision 2026-11-02].

device_id.description: Must equal header kid [TL Decision 2026-11-02 (kid = device id)].

exp.description: exp - iat <= 60 [SRC: LD L1365 (<=60 s)]; checked by the server.

claims.$comment: additionalProperties false: only the five TL-listed claims [TL Decision 2026-11-02]; jti/aud not used, single use comes from consuming the nonce [SSE Proposal -> OQ-35].
